note: Hand-entered figures from tools that do not expose usage data locally. These are NEVER merged into the measured token, energy, or time totals — those come only from Claude Code session logs. Prompt counts are combined, because a prompt is a prompt in either tool; nothing else is comparable. Keyed by project name, matching the extractor's output.

schema.tool: Name of the tool, shown to readers
schema.prompts: Typed prompts. Exclude canned approvals, empty messages, and any synced commit/build notices.
schema.words: Optional. Words written across those prompts.
schema.from / to: Range the figure covers (YYYY-MM). Use git history if the source has no timestamps.
schema.snapshotAt: When the figure was captured. Re-exporting later gives a higher number.
schema.method: How it was obtained, so the number can be re-derived or challenged.
schema.reportsTokens: false when the tool does not expose token counts — keeps the token figure honestly scoped.

milk-me-not.method: Chat history exported with lovable-chat-exporter, counted user-side messages (id suffix `copy`/`usr`), excluding 14 empty, 63 canned approvals, and all 258 GitHub sync cards. Cross-checks against 2,866 gpt-engineer-app[bot] commits in git at ~1.24 commits per prompt.
